note: A five-out-of-five core match, and the most important ICP finding in this batch because of what happened to him. Successful: owns his own film production company. Income: maintains homes in Andorra and Ibiza and stated twice, unprompted, that 'financially it's not a hardship' — about a product costing a sixth of the flagship. Neglected_health in its exact sense: no condition, no crisis, just two years deprioritised after a child arrived and the business demanded more, with injuries asked about directly and reported clear. Good_to_great is close to verbatim from the stated definition — 'I'm in a really good place... I want to take it to a greater level.' Not_deconditioned is emphatic: a lifelong high-level athlete across triathlon, motocross and soccer who was already training six or seven days a week before the call. THE FINDING: this is the ICP as written, and the rep proactively steered him off the $6,000 one-to-one product and onto the $1,000 self-paced platform without ever naming the higher price. Set against the icp.json observation that 'the buying population is wider than the stated ICP', this call adds the inverse and more uncomfortable point — the corpus also contains perfect-ICP prospects who are never offered the flagship at all. Any close-rate or ICP-conversion analysis that counts this call needs to know that the product under discussion was not the same product, or it will read a core-fit non-close where what actually happened was a deliberate $5,000 downsell.
